title: AI Agents Are Just a Loop #shorts
description:
An AI agent isn't a smarter chatbot - it's a loop: think, act, observe, repeat, until the job is done. Researchers call it ReAct (reasoning + acting).

Full 6-minute breakdown: How AI Agents Actually Work (Explained Simply) on DOS AI Explained.
Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/@DOSAIExplained?sub_confirmation=1

Source: Yao et al., ReAct (2022) https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.03629
